Two XMI trees are compared by recursive deep structural equality after normalisation: xmi:id attributes are stripped, EMF internal positional references are canonicalised (e.g. /0/@x.0 → //@x.0), XML attribute ordering is ignored, and text whitespace is normalised. The comparison checks element tags, attribute values, text content, child-element count, containment structure, and child ordering — all must match exactly for the mutant to be classified as ALIVE. Any structural difference yields KILLED. Only KILLED outcomes count as kills; INVALID_CONTAINMENT, INVALID_RUNTIME, ERROR, and ORIGINAL_FAIL outcomes are treated as invalid pairs and do not count toward killing or not-killed.
